svg.text: ANNOTATIONS
Loading
Skeletons shaped like the final content, so
the layout doesn't jump. Shown after 150 ms to
avoid a flash. A busy button shows a spinner
and is disabled.
Empty
Says what is empty, why it might be, and
offers one action. 'No data yet' and 'no match
for these filters' use different text.
Error
A plain message, filters and inputs are kept,
a Retry button, and collapsible technical
details. The page is never blank.
Partial failure
Each card owns its data request. A MongoDB
outage only affects the MongoDB-backed cards,
and the Postgres cards stay usable.
Screen readers
Booking results, errors and map updates are
announced through aria-live='polite'.
